comment: Raid quests (issue #22): Molten Core, Onyxia's Lair and Blackwing Lair quests that both factions take, with the quests they need. Chains only. Rules: tools/select_raids.py.

chains.name: Molten Core
chains.summary: 9 quests for Molten Core at required levels 55 to 60. The quests start with Lothos Riftwaker, Duke Hydraxis, Narain Soothfancy.

chains.name: Blackwing Lair
chains.summary: 8 quests for Blackwing Lair at required level 60. The quests start with Baristolth of the Shifting Sands, Anachronos, Vaelastrasz the Corrupt.
